slots.jd.credit-union.about:
Position summary
Weston Credit Union Services, a regional credit union, seeks a Junior Security Analyst to help protect member data and internal systems. The analyst will work in a hybrid arrangement from Richmond, VA, under the direction of senior security staff. Minimum requirements include working knowledge of incident response, log analysis and Nessus. A Security Analyst Certificate is preferred.
slots.jd.credit-union.duties:
Responsibilities
- Triage security alerts, determine their severity and escalate confirmed incidents to senior analysts.
- Track remediation of identified vulnerabilities and follow up with system owners until fixes are verified.
- Perform periodic access reviews and report inappropriate or outdated permissions for correction.
- Review firewall rules and system logs for activity that does not match established policy.
- Document findings, actions taken and open items in the team's tracking system.
slots.jd.credit-union.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 1 or more years of experience in a security analyst or related role.
- Working knowledge of incident response procedures and log analysis.
- Experience reviewing and maintaining firewall rules.
- Hands-on use of Nessus for vulnerability assessment.
- Familiarity with Python and Linux in an operational setting.
- Preferred: Security Analyst Certificate.
slots.r1.b1: Documents phishing simulation policies and procedures for staff campaigns, contributing to a 10 percent reduction in employee click rates on test emails.
slots.r1.b2: Tracks remediation of vulnerabilities identified in Nessus scans and follows up with system owners until fixes are confirmed.
slots.r1.b3: Builds security awareness training content from threat modeling findings, raising staff quiz scores by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Monitors security logs for unusual activity and compares alerts against vulnerability scanning results to flag exposed systems for senior review.
slots.r1.i1: Triages security alerts at Halcyon Services and escalates confirmed issues to senior analysts for review.
slots.r1.i2: Monitors system and network logs at Halcyon Services under the guidance of senior analysts.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level security analyst with about 1 year of experience handling well-defined tasks such as vulnerability scanning with Nessus under senior review. Uses PowerShell for routine tasks and applies threat modeling to support security assessments.
slots.summary.2: Information security analyst with about 1 year of experience and a B.S. in Cybersecurity from Ridgeway College. Works on scoped tasks with a senior colleague reviewing, using Nessus, PowerShell and threat modeling.
